messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Bob Sanders <bob.sanders@finlyhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo notes + immediate clarifications (PII, retention, marketplace flow)

Hi Alicia — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we keep momentum with procurement and security.

Summary from today's call:
- Integration: Finly will route anonymized claims metadata via the marketplace orchestrator; full PHI will never be forwarded to any marketplace telemetry vendors.
- Residency: Your primary requirement is that analytics/telemetry derived artifacts remain in us-east-1. Any backups must stay in-country.
- Retention: Logs/telemetry tied to PII must be retained for a maximum of 90 days unless explicitly required by regulatory audit.
- Subprocessors: You asked for a breakdown of our telemetry partners (heap/observability), cloud providers, and any marketplace connectors that could receive event-level data.

Immediate asks / action items (proposed):
1) I will share a concise subprocessor roster and a diagram showing where telemetry is generated and egress points (attached).
2) Can Bob and cloud-ops confirm if Finly requires a VPC-to-VPC peering or if S3 VPC endpoints are sufficient for marketplace ingestion? (Bob / cloud-ops)
3) Neha (cc'd) from our privacy team will follow up with the DPA clauses you flagged and confirm data minimization controls.
4) We propose a short security questionnaire specifically for telemetry vendors (5–7 items) — if that works, we can send it by Friday.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (10/28): I send the roster + diagram (attached).
- 10/29: Finly answers the peering/endpoint question + confirms retention constraint is acceptable for the integration pattern.
- 10/30: Privacy team provides DPA clarifications and any redlines.

Attachments: redwood-dataflow-diagram.pdf (diagram stub), finly-requirements-matrix.xlsx (matrix stub)

Thanks — happy to hop back on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Markus Klein

Thanks Alicia — answers below inline and next steps at the bottom.

Residency / failover: We can confirm that for the Finly integration we will pin telemetry storage and analytics to us-east-1. Any failover to another region requires a written change request and will be flagged in our incident runbook.

Subprocessor roster (summary):
- Observability: LogFlux Inc. (metrics + aggregated traces) — processes aggregated event metadata, no PHI stored.
- Telemetry batch transforms: PulseOps (data enrichment pipeline) — operates in us-east-1; configuration option to disable enrichment that retains identifiers.
- Marketplace connector: CloudBridge (managed connector) — only receives hashed identifiers unless Finly opts into enrichment.

We will provide the complete ATO-level vendor contact list in a follow-up PDF, but quick answers to Finly requests: 
- None of these subprocessors store or retain raw PHI by default.
- All are contracted to operate in us-east-1 for this engagement.
- We will provide egress IP ranges for CloudBridge and for our managed connector; if S3 VPC endpoints are acceptable we can work with cloud-ops to avoid NAT.

Attached: redwood-dataflow-diagram.pdf (shows where hashed/anonymized telemetry leaves Finly), finly-requirements-matrix.xlsx (fills gaps you noted).

Next steps / mutual action plan:
1) By 10/29 EOD — Markus sends the short vendor questionnaire to procurement@finlyhealth.com (attached matrix will include questionnaire).
2) By 10/30 — cloud-ops to confirm S3 VPC endpoints vs peering and note any egress IP constraints (Bob / cloud-ops).
3) By 10/30 — Neha to provide DPA language around retention and data minimization; Jasmine to list the telemetry vendor SOC/Sec reports available.

If useful, we can redact a sample telemetry event payload to show what leaves Finly (no PHI fields). Happy to set a 30-min tech deep-dive if cloud-ops wants to run packet-level checks.

Best,
Markus

Hi all — Neha from Redwood Privacy here. A couple of clarifying items before we share the DPA redline: 

1) Telemetry vendor questionnaire: please confirm the exact scope you want covered. We typically include: encryption at rest/in transit, region guarantees, access control (role-based), data minimization (fields retained), retention limits, and breach notification SLA. If Finly wants additional questions (certification-specific or live access), flag them and we will add.

2) Egress IPs vs S3 endpoints: if Finly uses S3 VPC endpoints and blocks outbound NAT, please confirm whether any marketplace connectors require outbound HTTPS to third-party endpoints. If yes, provide a short allowlist request and we will produce egress IP ranges.

3) For the residency guarantee we will add a clause that prevents failover to non-US regions without documented approval; however, please note that certain managed analytics features (e.g., global feature store replication) require opt-in and will be disabled by default for Finly.

Deliverables we will provide by 10/30:
- DPA redline highlighting retention and subprocessor obligations (Jasmine to attach SOC reports where available).
- Vendor contact list (ATO contacts) and a short encrypted payload example showing only hashed ids.

Alicia / Bob — if procurement wants the questionnaire sent to procurement@finlyhealth.com we will do that this morning.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Privacy Lead | Redwood Inference
